title: Public page: restyle the site in the black-and-red samurai theme of the README banner
story: The public website now looks like the samurai drawing at the top of the README. The Home page shows the drawing at the top in a red frame, with the headline and download buttons beneath it in place of the old side-by-side purple layout. Its animation now shows faint red tiles and falling pink petals instead of purple tiles. The Installation, Features and Troubleshooting pages swap the grey-and-blue dark theme for black and red, with the drawing as their logo.

checks.criterion: The Home page shows the samurai drawing whole in its hero, in black, red, white and petal pink only.
checks.steps: Open https://nachogl1.github.io/maestro/ in a desktop browser about 1440 px wide. Then narrow the window, or use a phone, to about 390 px wide.
checks.expected: At both widths the drawing (mask, katanas, MAESTRO SAMURAI lettering) is whole and nothing covers it. The headline, short description and two download buttons sit beneath it. The headline is in a brush font with 'One conductor.' in red. No blue or purple anywhere.

checks.criterion: The Home page still works with JavaScript off, with WebGL off, and with reduce motion set.
checks.steps: Turn on 'reduce motion' in the operating system and reload the Home page. Then turn JavaScript off in the browser and reload the Home page.
checks.expected: With reduce motion, one still frame of faint red tiles and pink petals, with no movement. With JavaScript off, a plain black-and-red background, with the drawing, text and buttons all there.

checks.criterion: The docs pages use the samurai colour scheme, with the drawing as the logo.
checks.steps: Open https://nachogl1.github.io/maestro/installation.html. Click 'Features' in the left menu.
checks.expected: Black page and sidebar, with the samurai drawing at the top left. The page title is in a brush font with a red brush stroke under it. Links are red. The current menu item has a red bar and a dark red background. Code blocks have a thin red border.
